description: Smoke-test subset: 10 easy OEIS conjectures with known outcomes -- the 5 tsoukalas_proved_38 members with the shortest gold proofs (correct answer: proof) followed by 5 robustly false conjectures, disproved and accepted in every one of the 15 historical result runs with the shortest published disproofs (correct answer: disproof). A quick end-to-end shakeout of the eval pipeline on both answer paths. Not a benchmark subset.
